title: Trace Them public profile lookup
description: Supply usernames OR email. The wrapper enforces mutual exclusion. Email links remain source-scoped; candidate scans require explicit opt-in.

usernames.title: Exact usernames
usernames.description: One to 100 exact usernames; omit when supplying email. All share one request budget.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email for public Gravatar resolution; omit when supplying usernames.

candidates.title: Scan inferred email candidates
candidates.description: Opt in to bounded nonrecursive username hypotheses. Matching accounts do not prove email ownership.

sites.title: Selected platforms
sites.description: Optional platform filter for username scans; source policy always applies.

maxRequests.title: Shared request budget
maxRequests.description: Maximum actual profile-source HTTP requests, including retries and redirects. Apify storage operations are separate.

offline.title: Disable profile-source network access
offline.description: Validate and generate an unqueried report without profile-source requests. The Actor still reads input and stores output through Apify.
